components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When present it must be
            one of 'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or 'DR' and, together with the last name, composes the
            returned 'salutation'.
          type: string
          pattern: "^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$"
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address (street
            number and name). Preferred over the flat 'address'; when present it is normalized
            (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations
            expanded) and, together with 'addressLine2', composes the returned 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address (unit,
            suite, etc.). Normalized like 'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the
            composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 3'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat value for
            backward compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields
            are supplied it is composed from them (the normalized 'addressLine1', plus a
            single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted with spaces, dashes
            and brackets and an optional leading '+' country code; stored and returned in
            E.164 form (a leading '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). When no country code is
            given, '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be four
            digits and, for a city whose region is known, fall within that region's range
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it determines the
            owner's 'ageBand', computed against the registrationDate. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Request-only flag. When true, allows creating this owner even though
            another owner has the same last name and postcode (i.e. they share a household),
            which would otherwise be rejected as a duplicate. Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans — the '+' country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
